scenicChapters.title: Black Mountain Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 85 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fuente-del-sauco-maina.story: 411 km from Letur to Letur, about 7 h 05 of riding. On the way it passes Canalejas de Abajo, Letreros de los mártires, Queso and maina. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Abrigo de la Llagosa → Diosa madre
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-abrigo-de-la-llagosa-cueva-del-ni.story: From Nerpio it runs 218 km to Nerpio; allow about 3 h 46 of riding. It goes by way of Diosa madre, Tenada de Cueva moreno, Cueva del Niño and back through Tenada de Cueva moreno. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
